docs.text: Overview is a brid created by @crLms1n that was added on January 18, 2026. Obtainment Not even 10 studs away from you when you spawn. Just walk toward it and you get it. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' At the start. ' and its description reads ' Honestly, just a normal brid. In fact, so normal that it has won the National Normal award of Bridtopia for 6 straight years in a row. No tricks, no weird distractions, /e verynormal, none of that. Just a normal brid living a normal life, with no obstructions whatsoever. None. ' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the first Brid. Before the precise rating system was removed, this Brid's rating was 1.00. In this Brid's aforementioned description, the code for Upside-Down Brid is hidden.

docs.text: Overview is a brid created by @crLms1n that was added on January 18, 2026. Obtainment Under a tree to the left of Farmer Brid's farm. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' A tree. ' and its description reads ' A normal Brid that was painted green because of the trees. ' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the second Brid. This Brid's design is just a green colored version of the original Brid. This green color is actually a default MS Paint preset color.

docs.text: Overview is a brid created by @Evanprice141 that was added on May 30, 2026. (Its original version was added January 18, 2026.) Obtainment On a tree in the Lava area, there is an eight-letter code. This code is a Pastebin link , which when visited reads " RHOLW]KPHKZPHLMXSZMX]IXHNJXKXIYT'4'T 'jpwoly.z'uhtl'pz'why{s 'hzzvjph{lk'~p{o'wsh nyv|uk'lx|pwtlu{5'^oh{'ht'PF'4'VTUP Good luck. ' This is an ASCII Shift Cipher shifted -7. Shifting it up to +7 reads ' KAHEPVDIADSIAEFQLSFQVBQAGCQDQBRM - My cipher's name is partly associated with playground equipment. What am I? - OMNI '. This is a Slidefair cipher, with the code being at the end (OMNI). Deciphering the ciphertext with the key gives you the text ' MYSTICALPOWERNINEZEROISYOURCODE '. Typing in ' /e mysticalpower90 ' in the code inputter will teleport you to the brid's subarea, where the Brid is just in front of you. Trivia This Brid's hint reads ' A tree. ' and its description reads ' A normal Brid that was painted green because of the trees. ' This Brid is one of the first 25 Brids added to the game, being the third Brid. This Brid is the first Brid added to be considered 'mind-numbing', being the bare minimum difficulty for it, Extreme. This Brid had an original version. You can view it Its original version also had the first part of its puzzle hidden in the console and not on a tree. This Brid has always been linked to Helpless Brid since Helpless Brid was added, where Helpless Brid's subarea was a branch off of Omnimagical Brid's subarea in some way.
